title: Card list service technical error
situation: You want to learn your credit card statement debt. Ask for it once at the start.
expected: - The card list service fails with a technical error; the assistant says honestly it cannot do the request now and hands the caller to a human agent (or follows the bank's fallback). It never invents a debt amount or card.

title: No eligible card
situation: You want to learn your credit card statement debt.
expected: - The customer has no eligible card; the assistant says there is no eligible credit card to query the statement debt for and routes to the main menu. No amounts are invented.

title: Slow balance service
situation: You want to learn your statement debt. If asked which card, say Yıldız Premium. Then thank them and end.
expected: - The debt of the Yıldız Premium card ending 7211 is read with amounts from the service even though the service answers slowly; nothing is invented; the call ends politely.
